A heavy wooden drinking stein made for tavern ale. Holds up to 4 drinks, refilled by right-clicking on a §5Beer Keg§r.

§6Drinking & Placement§r
• §7The Drunk Effect:§r Each drink inflicts 10 seconds of the §6Drunk§r effect, stacking up to amplifier IV. Expect swaying vision and stumbling movement.
• §7Decorative Placement:§r Sneak-right-click any solid block to place the mug down. Up to 4 mugs can cluster on a single block surface.
Crafted from any wooden barrel and a stick, or purchased directly from a Barkeeper.

§6Awakened Mug & Beer Spill§r
Fused with an §5Awakened Eye§r and an §bEcho Shard§r at a smithing table, the mug develops lively googly eyes and refuses to be drunk from.

Instead, right-clicking unleashes a §6Beer Spill§r extending 5 blocks forward. Monsters caught in the spray are afflicted with the §6Drunk§r effect, scramble their targets, and attack whatever living creature is closest to them.
